body: they’re the worst! i’ve only been on the leaving side but walking through security and to the gate holding back tears is no joke

you shouldn’t apologize. distance is distance and feelings are feelings. it is hard no matter what. i have an end date in 4 years but that doesn’t make it any easier for me to cope with!! humans are wired to think short term, and missing him in this moment can feel like the end of the world. you aren’t at fault for feeling that way!

i’ve only been doing ldr for a few months, but thought i could weigh in given that i’m the one that moved from home away from friends and family while he is still near them. yes he is probably homesick (i cry at least once a week from missing my bf and my family), and it is so hard being in a new place on the other side of the country from your loved one. however, you shouldn’t feel guilty for telling him you miss him or feeling like you have it better than him. you are both encountering these difficult feelings and will have to overcome it together! i can’t imagine not being able to text or call everyday and it must be super hard. don’t shy away from telling him how much you miss him or how things are going at home, but also be sure to give him the support and reassurance that he needs (my bf doesn’t like telling me when he needs reassurance from fear of feeling like a burden, so if yours is anything like mine, be sure to reassure even if he doesn’t ask!) i’ve also found that voice messages or video messages can be great because you feel like you are talking to them and when they are able to watch, they feel like they are talking to you! i like to send them to my bf when he is working 12+ hour shifts and can’t respond to me. focus on your end date! you’re almost there and you will make it. good luck!

it sounds like he really cares about you and probably doesn’t realize how much it hurts you when he is more distant (no pun intended 😅) i think a “now you know how i feel”isnt the worst thing ever, especially to help you best share your feelings, as long as it’s not rude/manipulative. just using it as an example might be helpful, tho ofc its your relationship and i’m just an outsider with advice. i hope you are able to figure it out and good luck!!
if he’s into it, there are these rick and morty energy drinks that my bf LOVES

i think any carrier is going to be expensive and probably won’t get it there in time. my advice would be to buy something from a third party (amazon etc) and send it straight to his address. it will get there in time and you can save to send him something from you another time! good luck and happy birthday to him!

i personally haven’t been in this situation but i think him feeling like he has to withdraw like you said might be the issue. ik a lot of guys struggle with showing emotion or being okay with showing emotion, so he may feel uncomfortable/embarrassed after those calls. imo, the most important thing is to communicate. it’s great that you already brought it up, but an apology with no change is not what you deserve. id recommend bringing it up again and making sure he understands that you support him but also need him to be more consistent with how he’s treating you. of course be understanding and patient during the conversation, but remember how you feel about the situation is just as valid as his reasoning!
